description: Fetch full details for several listings in one call — the normal follow-up to a search. Failed ids are reported in `errors` rather than failing the whole call, so a deleted listing does not lose you the rest.

includeViewCount.description: Also fetch view counts. Doubles the number of requests this call makes.

listings.description: Listing ids or ad URLs, typically from a search. At most 20.

name: kleinanzeigen_get_listings_batch
title: Get full detail for several listings
